name: Israa Shaheen
title: Protocol, etiquette and executive presence specialist
bio_short: Protocol and etiquette specialist with a decade of experience training executives, government entities and royal households across the GCC. Certified by the European School of Protocol and Protocolbureau in Brussels. MBA in leadership.
bio: Israa is a protocol and etiquette specialist with a decade of experience training executives, government entities and royal households across the GCC. She holds an MBA in leadership and human resources management from the University of Dubai and professional certifications from the European School of Protocol in London, Protocolbureau in Brussels, and the Dubai Etiquette Academy under William Hanson.  Her training clients include SAMA, SABIC, DEWA, DP World, Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, the Federal National Council, Borouge, the National Petroleum Construction Company, Oman Airports, Enterprise Estonia, the Roads and Transport Authority and the Royal Opera House in Muscat. Her courses cover business etiquette, international protocol, dining etiquette, executive presence, public speaking and event management, as well as specialist areas including protocol for hosting VIP delegations and cross-cultural business etiquette.  At ISOC, Israa delivers protocol and etiquette and executive presence programmes. Her experience training at the highest levels in the Gulf, including royal households and senior government bodies, gives her an understanding of the standards expected in formal and diplomatic settings. She translates this into practical guidance that professionals at every level can apply with confidence. Israa is based in Dubai and trains in Arabic and English.

Her courses cover business etiquette, international protocol, dining etiquette, executive presence, public speaking and event management, as well as specialist areas including protocol for hosting VIP delegations, cross-cultural business etiquette and netiquette.  At ISOC, Israa delivers protocol and etiquette and executive presence programmes. Her experience training at the highest levels in the Gulf, including royal households and senior government bodies, gives her an understanding of the standards expected in formal and diplomatic settings. She goes beyond surface-level etiquette rules to help participants understand the principles behind protocol conventions, enabling them to navigate unfamiliar situations with confidence rather than relying on memorised procedures. Her approach combines protocol knowledge with executive presence coaching, addressing how professionals carry themselves, communicate and create positive impressions in high-stakes professional and diplomatic encounters. Israa is based in Dubai and trains in Arabic and English.
